turns.question: What was our GMV in September 2026, counting every order placed, cancelled ones included?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no GMV metric (order value including cancelled orders); the closest are revenue_eur, which counts only non-cancelled orders (12,582.75 EUR for 1-30 September 2026), and orders_total, which counts all orders placed, cancelled included (120 orders in that period), but there is no value figure for cancelled orders. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
